analyst.summary: Fortis had a strong FY26: revenue up 17% and PAT up 32% on genuine hospital-occupancy and pricing gains, with margins improving and a credible plan to add ~500-600 beds and lift EBITDA margin further in FY27. The stock, though, already trades at a rich ~70x earnings and ~39x EBITDA multiple -- well above hospital peers -- so most of that good news looks priced in, and a modest one-time debt-funded acquisition spree has nudged leverage up. We rate it a Hold: a well-run, growing hospital business, but not cheap enough here to add.
